topic: Booking a peak season trip on credit vs saving a travel fund and traveling off season (Harvey vs Eunice)

scenes.narration: The same beach costs half as much three weeks later. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two calendars, one reads JULY with a tall price and one reads SEPTEMBER with a short price, comic burst banner reads HALF PRICE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Harvey and Eunice both want a week at the same beach resort.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man harvey and woman eunice looking at the same beach resort brochure, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Harvey books the Fourth of July week and pays with a credit card.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man harvey clicking BOOK on a calendar reading JULY FOURTH WEEK, a card in hand, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Flights, hotel, and rental car total four thousand two hundred dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a receipt listing FLIGHTS, HOTEL, CAR with a total reading FOUR THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Crowds everywhere. Two hour waits for dinner every night.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a packed beach and a long restaurant line, man harvey sweating in a crowd, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He pays the card off over ten months with interest.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man harvey looking at ten monthly payments on a statement, interest ticking up, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Eunice opens a travel fund and moves two hundred dollars a month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman eunice setting an automatic transfer reading TWO HUNDRED MONTHLY into a jar labeled TRAVEL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She books the third week of September at the same resort.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman eunice clicking BOOK on a calendar reading SEPTEMBER, a price tag half the size, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Flights, hotel, and car total nineteen hundred dollars, paid in cash.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a receipt with a total reading NINETEEN HUNDRED and a stamp reading PAID IN FULL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Empty beach, warm water, and a table the moment she walks in.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman eunice alone on a quiet beach, a restaurant host waving her to a table, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Harvey paid twenty three hundred more for crowds. Eunice paid cash.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man harvey in a crowd with a bill, woman eunice relaxed on an empty beach, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Save monthly, travel off season, pay cash. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
